title: Development of a Methodology for the Automated Spatial Mapping of Heterogeneous Elastoplastic Properties of Welded Joints
summary: Knowledge of the mechanical properties of materials is required for the design and analysis of engineering products, however, the characterisation of heterogeneous properties using traditional techniques is limited by spatial resolution or insufficient reliability. This paper presents a novel methodology for the characterisation of heterogeneous mechanical properties by extending the virtual fields method through the automated spatial parameterisation of constitutive parameters.
